description: Stablecoin peg status: live price and deviation in basis points from $1.00 ($0.01 USDC per call). First call (no payment_signature) returns the payment challenge; pay the exact USDC on Solana, then call again with payment_signature.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge. After sending the exact USDC amount on Solana mainnet to the pay_to wallet, call again with this set to the Solana transaction signature of your payment.

symbol.description: One of: usdt, usdc, usde, dai

name: get_peg
